name: SRIKANTH YADUGANI
title: ==LEAD AUTOMATION TEST ENGINEER==  |  JAVA & SELENIUM

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==Lead Automation Test Engineer== with 15+ years in QA and automation for financial services and retirement software. Hands-on experience enhancing Selenium WebDriver frameworks with Java and Cucumber/BDD, building reusable validation utilities, and integrating scheduled regression execution with Jenkins and Git-based pipelines. Experienced in API testing with Postman, SQL-based data checks, peer reviews and release coordination.

roles.title: Lead QA Software Engineer | progression from Trainee and Software Tester
roles.meta: February 2011 - September 2026 | Financial Services and Retirement
bullets: Enhanced and maintained Selenium-based automation frameworks using Java and Cucumber/BDD, applying XPath axis techniques for Ext JS application elements.
Automated in-sprint requirements and incorporated completed scripts into the regression suite for release validation.
Extended framework utilities for PDF comparison and validation, plan-health reports, file transfers and downloads, CCD Scrubber and CCD Splitter.
Scheduled weekly regression runs through GitLab and GitHub Pipelines and configured Jenkins jobs and Windows Task Scheduler executions.
Performed API testing with Postman and validated report data using SQL Server Management Studio and PowerSelect.
Contributed to migrating existing automation framework functionality to an Axiom-based implementation using Playwright libraries and TypeScript.
Reviewed code, estimated testing effort, identified delivery risks, mentored QA colleagues and coordinated QA/Production release activities.

roles.title: Lead QA Engineer / Senior Quality Analyst
bullets: Tested a platform for composing, integrating and delivering retirement and financial communications through print, email and online channels.
Environment included TurboTest BDD/Cucumber, Vega, Selenium, Java, Axiom, SQL, FTP, PDFBox, Maven and Postman.

roles.title: Quality Analyst
bullets: Executed Selenium/QTP regression scripts for participant and sponsor applications and developed Selenium automation for eCompliance.
